It's the first big update in quite a while! Quite proud of this one, hope you enjoy it.

Story & World Updates  
Entire world reworked into one big interconnected world map

Story intro cutscene added

New overarching storyline

Recruitable NPCs that help you in battle

New tutorial quests on the airship

Orvelte Farm added

New dungeon: Goblin Hole
  Combat & Progression  
Level progression balancing changed

Increased pace of battle

Max level raised from 20 → 30

New Job Classes:

Swordsman

Mage

Archer

Priest

New skills & spells
  Monsters & Resources

Goblin Mage and Goblin Bruiser

Cave Imp

 Gatherable monster dung and mushroom spots

  Controls  

Added Crouch ability

Gamepad support

  Visuals & Performance  

Visual improvements

Performance improvements

Many fixes to old bugs

Saving your location on logout


[hr][/hr]


Steam price adjustment

The price of the game on Steam has been aligned with other platforms (Meta Quest) to keep things consistent across the board. Thank you for your understanding.



What's next?!
The game is now in a stable place where new content can be made much more easily than before, so expect to see more new things in the near future! The focus of the next update will be player guilds and PVP, which I'm personally super excited about. Been looking forward to working on that for a long time now!

In terms of story content, the in-game world map and certain dialogue from the guild master in Eltstadt should give you an idea of what's to come next!

As always, thanks for playing QUEST TOGETHER!

notes.title: Multi-quest Update & Cute Pet System
notes.notes:
Multi-quest system

Any number of quests can now be accepted at once and completed at your own pace
Upon clearing a quest's objective, you'll see a notification that you completed the objective. Then hand in your quest at the Quest Girl at a guild tavern to receive your exp and your item rewards.
Manage your quests in your quest log: see which ones are active, which ones you've canceled, which ones are available, and how many times you've completed a quest.
Quests no longer take place in private instances, instead you can tackle quests in the public instance of the Hills/Tundra
Dosbullton, Wyrval, Goblins, and Wyvern Eggs are now all placed in the public Hills instance


Cute Pet system

Using specific "taming items" you can now capture certain monsters as pets.
While in battle with the monster you want to tame, use the taming item on it to have a chance at a successful capture.
The capture odds can be increased by damaging the monster; the lower its HP, the higher the capture odds.
After a successful capture, you'll obtain an Egg item.
"Equip" the Egg to spawn your pet
Your new friend will now follow you wherever you go!
You can Use the Egg again to despawn your pet, it'll go back into its egg safe and sound.
You can own any number of pet eggs, but you can only spawn one pet at a time.


Changes:

Redesigned the battle menu for VR: the new menu no longer obscures your view and instead is much more VR-user friendly. The desktop mode battle menu is unchanged.
Bug Nets and Pickaxes are now equipable items that equip to your hip slot. No more taking them out of your pouch every time you want to use them!
Removed the "Item Pouch" and "Carving Knife" as inventory items. No more accidentally unequipping the pouch or the knife, you'll simply have them equipped at all times.
Removed the automatic sending of items to the item box after leaving an instance, since it's no longer necessary since item pouches are now much bigger
Removed the "field item" label from freshly gathered items
Wyvern Eggs can now be stored in the item pouch like any other item
Lunalop drops Fluff instead of Herb now
Removed Target Practice (for now)


Fixes:

Fixed grass rendering on PC; it was using the Quest settings before which are unlit, now it's using the PC settings with proper shadows and everything
Fixed the private room warping you back to the wrong town after choosing "Visit room" at an innkeeper.
Fixed Snoqual tavern music continuing to play in the Tundra
Fixed the player vendor UI button being positioned wrong on desktop mode
Fixed some level design flaws in various places
Fixed an issue with selling items to the NPC vendor
Fixed the misplaced Kefla fairies in downtown Eltstadt
Fixed being able to equip things without taking them out of the item box first
Fixed purchased furniture not getting sent to the item box
Fixed the Rainbow Carrot being invisible
Fixed some quirky item box behavior
Fixed being able to buy more items from the npc vendor than the inventory allows
Fixed items used in battle showing a "used !" message in the battle log (item name was missing)
Fixed treasure chests granting you their contents over and over 😂

notes.title: Road map update for Q4 2024
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

As the final quarter of the year approaches, it’s time to share some updates about the game. With the recent introduction of the new combat system, the game has undergone a massive overhaul, changing both client- and server-side systems. There are two more system updates coming in line with those changes, here’s what to look forward to:

🛠️ Structural Updates

📜 Accepting Multiple Quests – Early October
Big changes are coming to how quests are handled! Until now, players could accept just one quest at a time and would be whisked away to a private instance. With the upcoming update, you’ll be able to accept multiple quests at once, keeping track of them in your quest list found in the menu. This means you’ll have the freedom to tackle quests at your own pace, which leads to the next big update…

🌍 Interconnected World Map – Late October / Early November
Keen-eyed adventurers may have already seen this one coming—soon, all game maps will be connected! The Forest & Hills area won’t be a standalone instance anymore; you’ll be able to walk there directly from Orvelte. New maps will also link Eltstadt and Orvelte, with a beginner-friendly cave (“dungeon”) connecting the fields between them. So get ready to explore even more of the world.

Once these changes are in place, the focus will shift fully to creating more content.

🏅 Content Updates

🛡️ Hero Rank 2: Eltstadt and Surrounding Areas – Late November
After proving yourself in Orvelte, it’s time for a promotion! Hero Rank 2 opens up quests in Eltstadt and the surrounding areas, offering new challenges and new places to explore.

Areas of operation:
EltstadtEltstadt Hills (North, West)Eltstadt Sewers

🌲 Hero Rank 3: Evermist Woods – Late December
Venture far to the west and discover the Evermist Woods, a dark and mysterious forest teeming with nocturnal creatures who prefer the cover of night. The woods are tricky to navigate, with winding trails and low visibility, so it’s best to come prepared! The guild will establish a base of operations here, complete with lodging and a quest board. Heroes level 20 and above will be able to brave these woods and find sanctuary at the guild’s outpost.

Monsters to encounter:
Orcs – Brutal, relentless fightersForest Golems – Towering, almost impervious to physical damageForest Feys – Small, shy creatures of the forest
☃️Update on Snoqual
With the late November update, Snoqual’s tavern will be temporarily closed until 2025. From then on, Eltstadt will serve as the HR2 quest hub. This adjustment aligns with the natural flow of gameplay, ensuring that areas near Orvelte (HR1) are explored before introducing players to a completely new biome. While the Snoqual quest board will be unavailable, the region itself remains accessible via the usual Kefla warps. Snoqual will have quests available again in a future update, further details will be announced closer to 2025.

That’s all I have to share for now. I’m really excited to work on this stuff and finally be able to deliver a new big amount of actual new content. When 2025 rolls around, expect another road map update!!! I plan to do these quarterly from now on.

Stay tuned, and thanks for being part of the adventure!

notes.title: Game Update! - The Big Combat Overhaul & Desktop Mode!
notes.notes:
Game Update! - The Big Combat Overhaul & Desktop Mode!

⚔️ Combat System Overhaul
Combat has transitioned to a brand new turn-based system! Start a battle by touching or attacking a monster, after which a circle will appear around you and your targets, indicating the battle radius. Players and monster inside the vicinity of the battle circle will be added to the battle automatically. See someone out in the field and they look like they could use some help? Just run up to the monster they're fighting and whack it on the head to join their battle! Up to 4 players can participate in a battle, and you'll see anywhere from 1 to 6 monsters per fight. 
Please note: This system is an on-going work-in-progress. Additional refinements and features are being worked on!

📈 Leveling System & EXP Rewards
Players can now level up! Gain experience points (EXP) from completing quests and defeating monsters, allowing you to increase your stats and grow more powerful over time. Your maximum level is tied to your Hero Rank, with a cap of 10 times your Hero Rank. So if you're HR2, your max level will be 20 until you get promoted to the next HR, at which point you'll be able to gain 10 new levels.

📊 Player Stats Introduced
New stats have been added to customize your character's abilities:
- **Strength (STR)**: Affects physical attacks.
- **Agility (AGI)**: Improves speed and increases evasion odds.
- **Vitality (VIT)**: Increases health and defenses.
- **Dexterity (DEX)**: Enhances weapon proficiency.
- **Magic (MAG)**: Boosts the potency of spells.
- **Luck (LUK)**: Increases chances of critical hits and dodges.
This system is still being experimented with. Currently stats will increment automatically as you level up. However, free stat allocation is something that's being considered for a future update.

🖥️ Desktop Mode Now Available
You can now play the game in desktop mode, no VR headset required! Play the full game on your PC using just your mouse and keyboard. Of course, it's fully cross-play with VR users, both on Steam and Quest.

:sparkles: Spells & Abilities
MAGIC! You can now use Spells! You will learn new spells by leveling up, and in the near future you'll be able to also learn new spells and skills by completing quests and villager requests. 

🌍 Level Redesigns
Several maps have been redesigned to align with the new combat system. Future updates will bring more map redesigns, as the game is moving to a more free exploration approach. Expect to see a redesigned Forest & Hills near Orvelte soon!

👹 New Noob-friendly Monsters
Two new enemies has been introduced. Meet the *Lunalop* and its big sister the *Doslunalop*. These creatures roam the fields around Eltstadt, and they're damn cute. 

🔄 Stamina Removed, SP Added
The stamina system is gone and replaced with **SP (Skill Points)**, letting you cast spells and use combat abilities in battle. 

:map: Minimap Added
A minimap system has been added to help you find your way through the game's (increasingly bigger) maps.

:art: Character Shading
Characters have been updated with a new toon shader, for a nicer stylized look.

:gem: Super Rare Monster Drops: Cards
Introducing **"cards"**—rare drops from monsters that grant stat boosts when equipped. These are super rare and highly valuable, so keep an eye out for them!

:scroll: Revised Intro Quest
The intro quest has been streamlined and NPC dialogue has been re-written somewhat, making it more clear for new players to be able to tell where they're meant to go.

:wrench: Additional stuff
- **Writing**: A bunch of new NPC's with new dialogue have been added.
- **Visual Updates**: Some visual changes have been made  to better accommodate lower-end hardware. (Quest 2...)
- **Bug Fixes**: Many many many bugs have been fixed over the past 6 months! (And lots of new ones have popped up I'm sure T_T)

Thanks for being here! Whether in VR or desktop mode, enjoy QUEST TOGETHER!!

notes.title: New update! Inventory overhaul, player vending, new monsters and new quests!
notes.notes:
Howdy all, here's the changelog for this new update:

New inventory system:

 The inventory has had a big overhaul
 The item box and the item bag are now separate inventories, you can put items in your bag permanently and they won't disappear when traveling between instances.
 Items like the Potion, Pickaxe and Bug Net are now "bag items," meaning they won't take up a precious item slot on your body anymore but will sit neatly in your bag.
 Dynamic item ownership: If you don't want an item anymore you can simply take it out of your inventory and toss it on the ground to discard it. Any item that leaves your inventory will not have an owner like before and can now be picked up by anyone, so you can now intuitively trade with people or simply give them stuff.
 Quest supply items are now indicated in your item pouch with a blue outline, so you can tell at a glance which items are yours and which will be returned after the quest.
 When you find an item out in the wild, it will now be a "field item" and have a green outline around its icon until you return from the quest/freeroam. Delivery quests, such as deliver 10 iron ores, will only accept field items. This is done so that you cannot cheat the system by bringing 10 iron ores from your item box and immediately turning them in on quest start, over and over.

Player vending:

 You can now sell your stuff to other players via vending in Eltstadt.
 Buy a Vendor License from any of the NPC shops in Elstadt or Orvelte for 500 Zin.
 When in Eltstadt, hold the License in your hand and press A to bring up the vending menu. (Make sure you're not too close to one of the city entrances or important npc's, as vending is prohibited in those areas to prevent impacting visiblity of important landmarks)
 Add the desired items from your item box and give them a price and name your shop.
 Once you press Start, a clone of your character will appear and your shop will open and stay open for 20 hours, or until your wares have sold out.
 Player shops are saved on a server level, so no matter which instance you're in you will see the same shops as everyone else so long as you're on the right map.

New small monsters:

 Goblin
 Caratroth
 Atanodo
 Snaproot
 Voraciflora

New quests:

 A Slimey Mess
 Goblin Disposal Squad

Quests coming soon:

 Fish for the chef
 Fight for the Stolen Jewels
 Investigate the uproar

Other changes:

 Fixed a bug that was impacting monster AI and trapping them in a loop.
 Monsters can move around more during combat now (you'll mostly see this with the goblin for now)
 Pictures taken with the in-game camera now automatically save locally to the /Pictures/Quest Together Photos/ folder.
 The drop rate for Slime Jewel has been changed from 1% to 3%.


Important!!! 
When you choose your character after downloading the update, it will take a minute to log you in. The server is transferring your old inventory to the new system and this can take a while. Once it's done you will have to re-equip your weapns and armor. 

When you get to your private room, you might find that your item chest is empty. In that case, simply restart your game and everything will be there. (this is a one time thing)

notes.title: New update is out! New intro quest, menu, NPC's & more
notes.notes:
Hello!

A new update is out now with some cool new things. Here's some of the changes:

 The title screen and main menu have been completely reworked.
 You can now create up to 3 characters per account! 
 You can delete old characters.
 A brand new intro quest has been added!
 A new small map has been added: Airship (only used in intro quest for now, will see more uses soon!)
 NPC's have evolved a bit, can now make noises at you whilst talking.
 Behind the scenes NPC's are now a lot more sophisticated, they can do things like navigate terrain and respond to enemies and events. You won't notice this yet except for in the intro quest, but this opens many cool possibilities.
 A variety of small adjustments and fixes have been added.


This is "part 1" of a larger update of sorts. I wanted to get the intro quest out there first, and will roll out some of the other things I've teased on Discord soon as well.

Thanks for playing, love you guys!
